findings.description: The draft asserted a causal relationship on the basis of a cross-sectional observational design. The design cannot distinguish causation from association.
findings.required_action: Withhold the causal licence. Either qualify the claim to the association the design supports, or withdraw it.
findings.resolution_note: Resolved at revision. Claim reclassified to unverified_claim, thesis restated as evidential insufficiency, and the claim listed in the unsupported-claim report. See sdl dec-00000003.

findings.description: The population 'older adults' exceeds the sampled population (ages 65-74, single urban cohort).
findings.required_action: Add a qualifier matching the evidence scope, or retrieve broader evidence.
findings.resolution_note: Qualifier node arg-00000006 added; scope bounded explicitly in the manuscript.

findings.description: Effect size reported without a confidence interval in the source. The absence should be surfaced, not silently carried.
findings.required_action: Note the missing interval in the uncertainty statement.
findings.resolution_note: Recorded as weak_support in the uncertainty statement.
